button.default: background 0.2s ease-in-out, border 0.2s ease-in-out, color 0.2s ease-in-out

chat.sidebar: transform 0.3s ease-in-out, width 0.3s ease-in-out, opacity 0.3s ease-in-out

&::after.background:
linear-gradient(
              to top right,
              transparent 49%,
            #E5E5E5 49%,
            #E5E5E5 51%,
              transparent 51%
          )
